name: Reno3

Network.Technology: Reno3, GSM / HSPA / LTE, Reno3 5G, GSM / CDMA / HSPA / EVDO / LTE / 5G

Platform.Operating system: Initial: Android 10 with ColorOS 7 UI, Current: Android 12 with ColorOS 12.1 UI
Platform.Chipset: Reno3: Mediatek MT6779 Helio P90 (12 nm), Reno3 5G: Mediatek Dimensity 1000L (7 nm)
Platform.CPU: Octa-core, Reno3: 2x 2.2 GHz Cortex-A75 & 6x 2.0 GHz Cortex-A55, Reno3 5G: 2x 2.2 GHz Cortex-A77 & 6x 2.0 GHz Cortex A55
Platform.GPU: Reno3: PowerVR GM9446, Reno3 5G: Mali-G77 MP9

Cameras.Rear camera: Quad-Camera, Reno3 4G:, 48MP 1/2.0" wide-angle (, 26mm), 13MP 1/3.4" telephoto (, 52mm), 8MP 1/4.0" ultrawide-angle (, 13mm), 2MP B/W (), Triple-Camera, Reno3 5G:, 64MP 1/1.72" wide-angle (, 26mm) with image stabilization, 8MP 1/3.2" ultrawide-angle (, 13mm), 2MP 1/5.0" B/W (), Video recording supports 4K@30fps and 1080p@30/60fps for 4G model, while the 5G supports the same supportable resolutions + 120fps + OIS; with gyro-EIS
Cameras.Front camera: Wide-angle, Reno3 4G: 44 MP, 26mm (wide), 1/2.8", Reno3 5G: 32 MP, 26mm (wide), 1/2.8", Both models support HDR

Battery.Charging: Reno3: Fast charging up to 30W, USB Type-C 2.0, Fast charging up to 30W, USB Type-C 3.1

Connectivity.Connectivity: Reno3: GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO, BDS , Reno3 5G: GPS (L1+L5), GLONASS, BDS, GALILEO, QZSS
